method: Double-sided CPU triangle heightfields sample an annulus inside the hat footprint, avoiding the exact head center/crest. Positive underside gap means air below the hat at that sample; negative means the head enters the estimated hat volume. Eye occlusion samples compare actual frontmost hat and body surfaces at metadata eye ellipses.
limitation: Annulus is a generic inner footprint, not a semantic stitched rim. Brims, diadems and hanging earflaps can produce legitimate gap/penetration samples. Diagnostics never substitute for native front/side review, and structuralPassed is not an artistic-fit pass.
